# Last Actor run's metamorph

The API endpoint described in this section is a convenience endpoint that metamorphs the Actor's last run into a run of another Actor.

Same as of functionality described in: [Metamorph run](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-metamorph-post.md)

<!-- -->

## [Metamorph Actor's last run](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-runs-last-metamorph-post.md)

[/actors/{actorId}/runs/last/metamorph](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-runs-last-metamorph-post.md)
